entries.title: Medieval Dynasty
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows PC release with latest updates and relevant DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Current PC release with Oxbow/co-op updates and current DLC/update content
primary.why: Medieval Dynasty launched on Windows PC before expanding to current-gen consoles, legacy consoles, and a separate Meta Quest VR spin-off. The PC release remains the best archive route because it has the highest capture/settings ceiling and the current update/DLC path, including Oxbow/co-op content, Echoes of Nature, Exquisite Pack, and the 2026 Full Stock update.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC build through Steam or another current PC storefront, install the latest patch, and include relevant paid DLC if the archive run is meant to document the current complete content set. Treat New Settlement as a separate VR spin-off, not a replacement.

entries.remaster_caveats: New Settlement is a standalone VR spin-off, not a remaster or replacement. Oxbow, Full Stock, and paid packs are updates/DLC for the main game rather than separate entries.
